text.en:
On Dodge:
Applies Misdirection to enemies within 22 metres.

Effects of Misdirection:
<pve Disorients minors and elites for 5 seconds. />
<pvp Warps audio and removes radar for 5 seconds, as well as briefly blinding. />

Misdirection doesn't actually deal damage.
(Less than 0.001 at the very least)
text.ko:
회피 직후:
22미터 이내에 있는 적에게 잘못된 방향을 부여합니다.

<pve 잘못된 방향이 부하들과 리더들을 5초 간 혼란에 빠트립니다. />

<pvp 잘못된 방향이 오디오를 일그러트리고, 레이더를 5초간 제거하며, 아주 잠깐 동안 실명에 빠트립니다. />

잘못된 방향이 부여될 때 1 피해를 입힙니다.
text.zh-chs:
躲闪时：
向 22 米范围内的敌人施加迷惑。

迷惑的效果：
• <pve 使普通和精英敌人混乱5秒。 />
• <pvp 扭曲声音并在 5 秒内移除雷达，并短暂致盲。 />

迷惑不会造成伤害。

text.en:
On Class Ability Usage:
Applies Misdirection to enemies within 22 meters.

Effects of Misdirection:
<pve [PVE] Disorients Minors and Elites for 5 seconds. />
<pvp [PVP] Muffles audio, briefly disorients, and removes radar for 5 seconds. />

Misdirection deals ~0 Damage but counts as a Hit.
